discovered_and_fixed.before: Verified claim about visa sponsorship passed grounding if it cited any real evidence id and contained no numbers (e.g. 'Google sponsors H-1B visas for Booth graduates' citing the employment-rate evidence).
discovered_and_fixed.fix: Topic rule: claims mentioning sponsorship/H-1B/visa must cite sponsorship evidence; claims mentioning STEM must cite STEM evidence.

discovered_and_fixed.before: Scholarship/fellowship odds ('your odds of receiving a scholarship are high') were not detected.
UI silently divided a whole-program budget by 2 and compared it to one-year cost of attendance.
discovered_and_fixed.fix: Explicit budget_period; total-program budgets are never converted and budget fit is 'unknown' with a deterministic explanation.

discovered_and_fixed.before: False positive: a correct warning ('any implication of guaranteed immigration benefit ... is unsupported') was flagged.
discovered_and_fixed.fix: Negation/hedge after the term within the same clause suppresses the flag; real guarantees still flagged.

discovered_and_fixed.before: Instruction-like text in profile fields or source excerpts was only countered by prompt wording.
discovered_and_fixed.fix: Deterministic injection screen on all profile strings and on evidence excerpts/titles; tool results wrapped as untrusted data.

discovered_and_fixed.before: Emails/phone numbers/passport numbers typed into free-text notes were accepted (only extra fields were blocked).
discovered_and_fixed.fix: PII screen on all profile strings.

known_limitations: Pattern-based screens can be evaded by paraphrased injections; the second line of defence is that model output cannot create facts (grounding overwrites statuses and drops unsupported claims).

The negation-after rule can miss a real guarantee followed by a hedge in the same clause (e.g. 'a guaranteed job, which is unknown to many'). risky_language is a flagging aid; verified claims still need evidence.
Free-text fields outside claims (fit rationale, tradeoffs) are flagged, not removed, for risky language; the post-run audit (scripts/verify_run.py) checks their numbers.
No paid model was attacked live in this step; these tests exercise the deterministic defences that sit around the model.
